text:
Sana: LAN night idea — anyone up for Saturday? thinking Switch + Steam party at the office, 7pm start. bring controllers/monitors if you can.
Ben: Ooh yes. Can we do Smash + Rocket League?
Kira: I’ll bring my Switch + Smash roster (and snacks). :chipmunk:
Leo: Steam PC here — will bring monitor and ethernet cable. anyone have a spare switch dock?
Jamie: I’m down. Can’t host at home this time so office works. is there enough table space?
Sana: Office conference room A is free after 6, we can move the chairs and plug in a power strip. coord with facilities for extra tables? @facilities if you see this
lanbot: Reminder: please fill the quick poll so we can plan games/food — https://tinyurl.com/redwood-lan-poll (2 questions)
Ben: Poll done — I voted for Smash, RL, and an old-school CS:GO lobby if people want.
Kira: Would anyone be into a short Mario Kart warmup? 4-player split-screen on Switch is chaotic but fun.
Leo: I can bring a 5-port gigabit switch so we’re not all on Wi‑Fi. also I have an HDMI switch if we need to toggle consoles on one monitor.
Jamie: I’ll grab extra controllers and a couple of extension cords. also volunteer to man the playlist (chill game soundtrack) :headphones:
Sana: Perfect. Plan: arrive 7pm, set up 6:30. if you’re bringing a monitor/PS/PC, drop a quick reply so we know how many screens.
Ben: Bringing PC + monitor.
Kira: Switch + dock.
Leo: Monitor + network gear.
Jamie: 2 controllers + power strips.
Sana: Awesome — I’ll DM facilities to confirm room and post a short calendar invite. see you Saturday! :party_popper:
